title: Fixed internal-Hom continuity and evaluation-defined scalar comparisons
statement: On a ringed site with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention], use the module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], their ordinary unbounded derived categories and localization functors $Q_R$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and the fixed functorial K-injective representatives of ambient derived internal Hom $H_R$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom]. For $K\in D(R)$ put $\Gamma_K(P)=\mathcal Hom_R(Q_R^{-1}K,I_R(P))$, using exactly the chosen representative of $K$ and the fixed functorial resolution $I_R$. For every sequential diagram $D$ of complexes define the continuity map to be $Q_R(\operatorname{colimit.post}(D,\Gamma_K))$, from $Q_R(\operatorname{colim}(D\Gamma_K))$ to $Q_R\Gamma_K(\operatorname{colim}D)$, with the ordinary termwise sheaf colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Define $\mathrm{HasLocalizationHomContinuity}(K)$ to mean that this map is an isomorphism for every $D$ admitting one common termwise lower bound. For any map $a:R\to S$ of commutative ring sheaves, use the actual normalized scalar models, $F_a\dashv U_a$, the strong derived tensor comparison $\mu_a$, and the evaluation-normalized scalar-Hom adjunction $\alpha_a$ [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data], with the closed tensor and evaluation [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model]. Define $\chi_{a,K,L}:F_aH_R(K,L)\to H_S(F_aK,F_aL)$ to be the transpose over $S$ of $F_a(\operatorname{ev}_{K,L})\circ\mu_a^{-1}$. Define $\rho_{a,K,L}:U_aF_aH_R(K,L)\to H_R(K,U_aF_aL)$ to be $\alpha_a\circ U_a(\chi_{a,K,L})$. These are constructions, with no continuity, boundedness or invertibility assertion about $\chi$ or $\rho$.
